<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Requires 0 < H_safe + y_safe, RegimeMargin.Meets/FromNothing/AtMost/Keeps on saturating substrates, ServiceTaskModel throughput/upkeep parameters, (H_safe + y_safe) + drawCeiling * (lag + 1) ≤ B_task for timely turning, and both obs_detects₁ and obs_detects₂ for live ReconfigProcess swaps.
